record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.context_brief: Harmonic maps from disc to sphere
record.original_question: Let Ω be the unit disc in R^2, let 0<R<1, prescribe boundary data g(x,y)=(Rx,Ry,√(1-R^2)) on ∂Ω, and consider harmonic maps u:Ω→S^2 satisfying Δu_i=u_i|∇u|^2 in Ω and u=g on ∂Ω. The paper exhibits two explicit solutions u and ̃u. Are there any other solutions besides these two?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega = \{(x,y)\in\mathbb{R}^2 : x^2+y^2<1\}$ be the open unit disc in $\mathbb{R}^2$, and let $S^2 = \{p\in\mathbb{R}^3 : |p|=1\}$ be the unit sphere. Fix a parameter $R\in(0,1)$ and define the boundary map $g:\partial\Omega\to S^2$ by
$$g(x,y) = \bigl(Rx,\; Ry,\; \sqrt{1-R^2}\bigr).$$
A map $u=(u_1,u_2,u_3):\overline{\Omega}\to S^2$ in $C^2(\Omega;S^2)\cap C(\overline{\Omega};S^2)$ is called a harmonic map satisfying the Dirichlet condition $g$ if
$$\Delta u_i = u_i\,|\nabla u|^2 \quad\text{in }\Omega\ \text{for }i=1,2,3, \qquad u=g \text{ on }\partial\Omega.$$
It is known that this problem has at least two distinct solutions $u$ and $\tilde u$, which can be written down explicitly (one with image in the upper hemisphere and one whose image wraps around to cover $S^2$).

Determine whether there exist any solutions to the above Dirichlet problem other than these two known solutions $u$ and $\tilde u$.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches indicate that for non-constant boundary data on the disc to S^2, the existence of at least two solutions (a minimizer and a second critical point of Brezis–Coron type) is classical, but the question of whether the explicit symmetric boundary data $g(x,y)=(Rx,Ry,\sqrt{1-R^2})$ admits exactly two harmonic-map solutions appears to remain open. Related works on symmetric boundary values and symmetry breaking (e.g., M. Pierre, 2008) study multiplicity but do not settle uniqueness modulo the two known solutions.

status_evidence.title: Symmetric boundary values for the Dirichlet problem for harmonic maps from the disc into the 2-sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Studies existence of multiple solutions of Dirichlet problem for harmonic maps disc->S^2 via symmetries; does not resolve uniqueness for the specific symmetric boundary data.
status_evidence.claim: Multiplicity question for symmetric boundary data remains studied without settling exact count.

status_evidence.title: Multiple solutions of the Dirichlet problem for harmonic maps from discs into 2-spheres
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes at least two solutions for non-constant boundary data into S^2.
status_evidence.claim: At least two solutions are known; whether there are more is not resolved here.

status_evidence.title: Large solutions for harmonic maps in two dimensions (Brezis–Coron)
status_evidence.snippet: Brezis–Coron show existence of a second (large) solution in addition to the minimizer.
status_evidence.claim: Two solutions are guaranteed; uniqueness beyond these is not established.
